t: A web page that explains the MENACE matchbox machine as an early learning example.
steps: Find the Matchbox computer page in the Explorable Data Science project.
Read the page in English or German.
Decide whether the page suits your class. It describes no lesson.
Plan your own activity around the idea.
Gather matchboxes and beads if you want a physical version.
Check the age range yourself. The page gives none.
Check the site for other exhibits that might help.
